digest.component_or_area: bug close workflow and ticket state reduction
propositions: The current `--reason` parameter on bug close is validated but never persisted to ticket state, wasting user input; a required `--class` enum parameter must replace it and be folded into reduced state so it survives and is queryable.

The `close_class` field must be added to `status_data` during bug close transition and explicitly folded into reduced ticket state via a new `_fold_close_class` helper in both fork-winner and normal-update branches of `process_status`, otherwise it never surfaces to `rebar show`.

Two validation sites must be updated to accept and validate `close_class`: the `transition_core` guard in `txn.py` (replacing `bug_close_reason_ok`) and the `_completion_precheck` in `transition_close.py`.

CLI users must receive a nonzero exit and error message listing allowed enum values when `--class` is omitted on bug close, and invalid values outside the bounded vocabulary must be rejected with nonzero exit.

The `ticket_state.schema.json` must be extended with an optional `close_class` field to document the new state key; the enum vocabulary includes `regression`, `plan_defect`, `env_integration`, `flaky`, `preexisting`, `not_a_bug`, `duplicate`, `escalated`, and `undetermined`.
